name: Relationism (jogo funcional)
scopeNote: Relationism as a non-zonal, ball-centred attacking idea in which position is a function of relationships between players. Exemplar: Fernando Diniz's Fluminense (second spell 2022-04-30 to 2024-06-24, peak 2023 Copa Libertadores), with his first Fluminense spell (from 2018-12-19) as precursor. The term 'relationism' was defined by Scottish coach and writer Jamie Hamilton (Medium, 2022; the primary 'What is Relationism?' text was not read: Medium returned 403, so the definition is taken from his interview with Elite Soccer Coaching and from secondary sites); in Brazil the style is called 'Dinizismo' and Diniz himself uses it little (he says the tactical part is not fundamental). 'Jogo funcional' is a Brazilian term for related ideas (functional play) and was not directly sourced for Diniz. A popular label, 'opposite of Guardiola', is simplified: Sky Sports experts note Fluminense also keep the ball, overload and counter-press like De Zerbi/Guardiola, and The Football Analyst (2025) says the best modern teams blend both. Term coinage date (Nov 2022) comes only from a search summary and is unverified.
openQuestions: Ids: fernando-diniz (manager) and fluminense-2023 (team) already exist in the catalog and are proposed as exemplars; no new ids invented.

Hamilton's primary text 'What is Relationism?' (Medium) and 'The Mutants' were unreadable (403); the definition is therefore second-hand via Elite Soccer Coaching and The Football Analyst. Mine Hamilton's own pages in a manual pass.

Marking: no source found that settles zonal vs man-oriented. The Football Analyst says Diniz 'usually wants man-to-man' pressing only in a search summary (unverified); Sky Sports (Pivetti) says players hold positions when losing the ball, and Lance (2019) says high line with compaction. Treat as unresolved.
'Jogo funcional' not found as a Diniz or Hamilton term in this run; confirm whether the catalog title should keep it.

Several secondary pieces (Football Analyst 2025, FM guides) are descriptive and may restate Hamilton; relationism's claim of 'tilt to one side' is verified for Fluminense only in The Football Analyst's 2024 analysis.
Hamilton's 'moment of clarity' and the coinage date (Nov 2022) are from the manager file and a search summary, not re-verified here.

statedView.quote: O central do meu trabalho é estabelecer boas relações humanas. Que eles se sintam bem, que possam errar sem ser atacados o tempo todo. Futebol é uma arte, é como pintar, tocar uma música.

O que é variação tática? Sair com bola longa? Olha quantas bolas longas o Fluminense fazia por jogo. O cara acha que variação tática é baixar a linha. E o Fluminense marcava muito bem em linha alta, linha média e linha baixa.
With all the teams I worked, I adapted to the team
In relationism, position of a function of the interactions and relationships between the players. So the position is actually secondary
